name: Amara's Private Quarters

A worn leather tube contains tide charts marked in pencil.
A small wooden flute rests on the shelf beside a tin of salve.

Play a short tune on the flute
windowOutlook: A low window looks across the stone breakwater to open water and passing fishing boats.

A brass telescope rests on the windowsill.

interiorStyle: A plain room with salt-white walls, a single bed against the back wall, a square table in the center, and a sea chest under the window. A lantern hangs from a ceiling hook and the floor shows scuffed boards from daily use.

Measure a length of rope for a new splice

name: Calista's Private Room

A leather ledger with worn edges rests beside the bottle.
A pair of clean gloves lies on the washstand.

interiorStyle: Compact room with mahogany floor, deep indigo wall hangings, a brass lantern on the table, and a narrow bed with salt-white linen

interiorStyle: Modest room with salt-stained stone walls, a low bed with checked cotton cover, a pine table with two stools, and a single brass lantern

interiorStyle: Narrow room with weathered planks, a single lantern on a hook, faded tobacco-brown blanket on the bed, and a simple pine table with one chair

interiorStyle: small room with weathered mahogany floorboards, whitewashed walls showing salt stains, a single lantern on a hook, and a simple wooden chair pulled up to the table

Brew tea and practice a short exchange with the foils

A collection of dried herbs hangs from a beam above the window.

Plan a windowsill herb box from the seeds

activities: Review new market finds on the table
windowOutlook: A tight view down a lantern-lit alley where market carts pass and shutters creak in the breeze.
interiorStyle: Small square room with salt-stained stone walls and a single lantern on a hook. The bed has a deep indigo coverlet, the table is plain mahogany with brass fittings, and a chest of folded linen sits at the foot.

name: Rafiq's Quarters
description: Rafiq keeps a compact room above a rope loft near Admiralty Quay. A narrow bed sits under a slanted ceiling, with a small table for meals and a bench along one wall. A shelf holds folded charts and a few carved wooden figures from the cays.
details: A dented brass tankard rests on the table, used for morning coffee or evening rum.
A rolled fishing net leans in the corner, its mesh patched with thick twine from past repairs.
A stack of folded sailcloth cushions serves as extra seating when friends drop by after a crossing.
activities: Swap fishing stories over a tankard
Plot a voyage with the wooden cay figures
windowOutlook: A narrow view across the quay rooftops toward the ferry dock and shifting channel buoys.
interiorStyle: Low-ceilinged room with weathered mahogany planks, salt-white walls, and a single lantern hung from a hook. The bed has a striped indigo blanket, the table is scarred from knife marks, and a chest holds spare clothes under the bench.

name: Roxana's Room
description: Roxana's room stands on the upper floor of a small building in the Outer Cays. A bed with a travel chest at its foot takes up most of the space, and a low table holds a rum bottle and tide charts. Shutters open toward the reef line.
details: A brass tide gauge sits on the table beside the charts, its markings worn from frequent use.
A coiled salvage line hangs from a peg, ready for quick repairs or measurements.
A wooden rum cup rests near the chest, marked with a small carved reef pattern.
activities: Pick a calm crossing from the tide charts
Teach each other a salvage knot
windowOutlook: An angled view over low rooftops to the outer reef where breakers show white in the distance.
interiorStyle: Compact room with patched sailcloth curtains and salt-worn mahogany boards. The bed has a sea-turquoise blanket, the table is low and simple, and a single lantern hangs above the chest.

name: Rune’s blue Lantern Room
description: Rune's room at the inn holds a travel chest and a low stool. A length of rope hangs from a hook for knot practice. A small bottle of grog stands on the windowsill.
details: A coil of tarred rope lies ready on the stool for tying practice.
A worn deck of cards rests in a tin box on the chest lid.
A clay bottle of grog sits beside a tin cup.
windowOutlook: Salt-streaked shutters open toward the dark reef line and the lantern glow of distant cays.
interiorStyle: Compact corner room with weathered plank walls, a single lantern on a bracket, a narrow bed with patched canvas cover, and a sea chest at the foot.

name: Sabine’s gilt Row Quarters
description: Sabine keeps a private room behind the salon terrace. A small table holds her tea blending jars and a wooden flute. A lacquered box of perfume vials stands on a shelf.
details: A row of small glass jars on the table contains dried herbs and petals for tea.
A simple wooden flute rests on a folded cloth beside the jars.
A lacquered box holds several stoppered perfume vials.
activities: Play a short tune on the flute
windowOutlook: Tall shutters overlook the terraced roofs and the lantern-lit harbor beyond the salon district.
interiorStyle: Rectangular room with pale gold walls, a low table with two cushions, a carved shelf for the flute and vials, and a narrow bed with indigo linen.

name: Sable’s blue Lantern Room
description: Sable keeps a small room at the same inn with a washstand and a folded hammock. A tide table hangs on the wall beside a deck of cards. An empty rum bottle serves as a candle holder.
details: A folded tide chart lies on the washstand with pencil marks.
A deck of cards sits in a cloth pouch on the hammock edge.
A dark rum bottle holds a stub of candle.
activities: Mark the next tide window on the chart
windowOutlook: The single window faces the shallow reef channel and the low shapes of moored boats at dusk.
interiorStyle: Small square room with dark wood walls, a washstand with basin, a hammock slung between beams, and a single stool.

name: Sami’s battery Quarters
description: Sami keeps a modest room above the breakwater stores. A narrow table holds his current ledgers beside a basket of dried fruit from the night market. A coil of fishing line rests on a peg near the door.
details: A bound ledger with ink-stained pages sits open on the table for evening tallies.
A woven market basket holds wrapped parcels of smoked fish and bread.
A short fishing rod leans against the wall with hooks threaded on a cord.
activities: Challenge each other to a market-price guessing game
Plan a fish supper from the day’s catch
windowOutlook: Narrow panes look across the stone breakwater toward the open harbor mouth and passing sailboats.
interiorStyle: Small rectangular room with whitewashed walls, a single mahogany table, two straight chairs, and a low rope bed under a salt-stained wool blanket.

name: Seraphine Vale's Private Quarters
description: Seraphine Vale keeps a second-floor room on Gilt Row. The space includes a desk for ledgers and a corner table for personal projects away from the bank. It offers a place to unwind after daytime meetings.
details: A half-finished ship model sits on the desk beside a set of carving tools.
A potted orchid in a brass holder stands near the window for daily care.
A folded theater program rests on the shelf with notes from recent plays.
activities: Work on the ship model together
windowOutlook: Harbor terraces and docked merchant vessels below the row of stone buildings.
interiorStyle: Medium square room with deep indigo walls, polished mahogany desk and chair, a narrow bed with gold-trimmed coverlet, and a side table holding the orchid under lantern light.

name: Sora Bay's Private Quarters
description: Sora Bay keeps a modest house on Windward Cay. The main room contains a table for meals and a bench for mending gear after fishing runs. It stays ready for council talks or simple rest.
details: A mending needle and coiled line rest on the bench for net repairs.
A heavy iron pot hangs near the hearth for cooking fresh catch.
A small wooden box of dried feathers sits on the shelf from sea-bird sightings.
activities: Mend fishing line at the bench
Cook a simple meal in the iron pot
windowOutlook: Rocky shoreline and the reef line visible through salt-streaked panes.
interiorStyle: Rectangular room with whitewashed stone walls, a central plank table, two benches, a brick hearth, and open shelves holding clay jars and coiled rope.

name: Stellan Rook's Private Room
description: Stellan Rook keeps a room at the Blue Lantern Inn in Lantern Market. The space holds a bed, a washstand, and a chair that doubles for storage after long nights at the door. It serves as a quiet place once the harbor quiets.
details: A set of iron weights sits under the bed for morning training.
A deck of worn cards lies on the table for late games with visitors.
A shallow dish holds gold chains and spare coins beside the washbasin.
windowOutlook: Narrow alley between two stone buildings with laundry lines overhead.
interiorStyle: Small square room with faded turquoise plaster, scarred floorboards, a low rope bed with salt-white linen, one three-legged table, and a wall hook for a coat.

name: Talia Wren's Private Quarters
description: Talia Wren keeps a compact room above the breakwater in Tidemark. A narrow bed sits against one wall beside a sturdy table that holds her tools and a small oil lamp. The space stays practical for long watches and quick rests between shifts.
details: A brass lighthouse lens rests on the table for polishing between shifts.
A wooden flute leans against the chair for evening music practice.
A pair of birding glasses hangs near the window for spotting seabirds at dawn.
activities: Play a tune on the wooden flute
windowOutlook: Open harbor water and the distant line of outer cays under shifting clouds.
interiorStyle: A single low-ceiling room with salt-stained plank walls, a worn mahogany table, one straight chair, a narrow rope bed with indigo canvas cover, and a wall peg for oilskins.

name: Tessera Pike's Room
description: Tessera keeps a plain room at the Blue Lantern Inn in Breakwater Point. A wooden stool holds a wrapped bundle and a tin cup sits on the floor beside the bed. Worn floorboards show the path to the door.
details: A pair of wrapped hand straps for fighting lies on the stool.
A folded sheet of fight odds rests under the tin cup.
A dark bottle of grog stands half-full beside the bed.
activities: Wrap the hand straps for practice
Compare the latest fight odds on the sheet
windowOutlook: A stretch of open water beyond the breakwater with a few anchored boats visible.
interiorStyle: Rectangular room with weathered plank walls, one brass lantern, a low bed with gray blanket, and a single stool near the door.

name: Tomas Renn's Quarters
description: Tomas keeps a compact room above a narrow quay building in Admiralty Quay. A low table holds his flute and a stack of harbor papers near a narrow bed with a wool blanket. A small iron stove sits ready for stew in the corner.
details: A simple wooden flute with worn finger holes lies on the table beside a stack of folded charts.
A leather-bound ledger of past ferry schedules rests on a shelf above the bed.
A heavy iron pot with a wooden ladle stands on the small stove near the window.
activities: Play a melody on the wooden flute
Trace routes on the harbor chart
windowOutlook: A narrow slice of the working quay with docked ferries and stacked cargo crates below.
interiorStyle: Small rectangular room with salt-stained plank walls, a single lantern on a hook, a low wooden bed against the back wall, and a scarred table under the front window.

name: Vesperine Crowe's Room
description: Vesperine keeps a small room at the Blue Lantern Inn in Gilt Row. A travel chest sits at the foot of the bed and a narrow shelf holds a few glass bottles. Salt-worn shutters open onto the terrace roofs.
details: A short practice blade with a wrapped grip leans against the wall beside the chest.
A small glass perfume bottle with a brass stopper stands on the shelf.
An empty champagne flute rests upside down on the windowsill.
activities: Compare two scents from the perfume shelf
Invent a name for a new perfume blend
windowOutlook: Slanted roofs of neighboring terraces and a slice of the harbor beyond the inn courtyard.
interiorStyle: Narrow room with whitewashed walls, a single brass lantern, a low bed with striped cotton cover, and a pine travel chest under the window.

name: Yara Nouri's Quarters
description: Yara keeps a modest room in a Ropewalk boarding house. A coil of rope and a small wooden box sit on the floor near the bed. A faded towel hangs from a peg by the door.
details: A length of hemp rope tied into three different knots hangs from a wall hook.
A small tin box of citrus sweets rests on the windowsill.
A wooden peg puzzle with carved pieces lies on the low table.
activities: Untie and retie the knotted rope
Solve the wooden peg puzzle together
windowOutlook: A cluttered yard with stacked lumber and a partial view of the ropewalk sheds.
interiorStyle: Small square room with dark-stained wood walls, a single oil lamp, a narrow bed with canvas cover, and a low bench against the side wall.
